title: Shin Gakkou no Yuurei
justification: TVDB 456511 season 1 holds the six Gakkou no Yuurei OVAs (node 6102), so offset 6 pointed past its end. The 1999 OVA is season 0 episode 1 Shin Gakkou no Yuurei (41 minutes), the series' only special; TVDB lists AniDB 18978 beside 6102. The offset is stated as 0 so the season 0 placement is published.
